_doc: SAMPLE lists for the public copy of Avallone. The live shard's townsfolk pasts are hand-written and kept private; these invented lines show the shape. Each townsperson gets one home, one former life and one past event, the first time one is needed, and keeps them. Tags keep a biography from contradicting itself (pairs) and from clashing with a present trade.

homes.text: Born in this town, and has never seen much reason to leave.
Born here during a hard winter, as the family tells it.
Born in the rooms above the old bakery, and has never left that street.
Came from Britain, looking for a quieter life.
Came from Vesper after a falling-out with a cousin.
Came from Yew, and still misses the trees.
Came from Minoc, high in the mountains, and has never once set foot on a beach.
Grew up on a farm a day's walk from here.

lives.text: Worked the fishing boats up and down the coast.
Sold pies from a tray at country fairs.
Kept the accounts for a merchant house.
Cut stone in a quarry for twenty years.
Painted signs for inns up and down the roads.
Carved wooden toys to sell on market days.
Wrote letters for people who could not write their own.
Washed pots in the kitchen of a busy inn.
Dug for clams along the shore at low tide.
Kept the bees for a wealthy family.

events.text: Once found a silver ring baked into a loaf of bread.
Spent a summer building a boat that sank on its first day out.
Once raced a neighbour round the town walls for a sack of flour, and lost.
Once counted every step from the gate to the well, and still knows the number.
Once rowed across a lake at night just to win an argument.
Has a scar on one thumb from a long fight with a stubborn jar lid.
Can recite the names of every king in the old chronicle.
Took in a stray dog that followed them home one rainy night.
Saw a falling star as a child and still makes a wish every night.
Swapped a perfectly good hat for a pocketful of marbles as a child.
Was trusted to ring the town bell at a festival, and rang it an hour early.
Grew a turnip so large it was carried through the streets on a cart.
Lived a whole month on nothing but porridge, to settle a wager.
Spent a whole spring trying to teach a goose to fetch.
Caught a fever once and still talks about the dreams it brought.
Helped put out a fire in a neighbour's barn.
Lent a stranger a cloak and got it back years later, freshly mended.
Was so seasick on their only voyage that they never sailed again.
Tamed a crow that now steals buttons for them.
Carved a chair that the tavern still uses.
Climbed the tallest tree for miles on a dare.
Has never once lost at knucklebones, or so they claim.
Once met a wizard who would not stop talking about frogs.
Trained a sheepdog that was cleverer than most people they know.
